name: tnp-portal
description: IIIT Lucknow Training & Placement Portal. Node workspaces cover the Next.js frontend and the Prisma-owned database package; the API lives in the Python backend/ service.
overridesRationale: Pins @auth/core to the patch version next-auth 5 expects, so the JWT and Session augmentations in frontend/src/types/next-auth.d.ts keep matching the runtime types. The original conflict was with @auth/prisma-adapter, which was removed when sign-in became password-only.

scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace @tnp/frontend && npm run type-check --workspace @tnp/database
